content.short: Monorail is a Monad swap aggregator combining AMMs, on-chain order books and RFQ liquidity.
content.description: Monorail combines AMM pools, on-chain order books and RFQ liquidity into one model so any token on Monad can be traded through a single route. Its synthetic order books present aggregated liquidity as a unified book rather than separate venues. Integrators can connect to the aggregate or to the order book layer directly.
